research_mode: official Home Office sources only; police-recorded-crime open-data schema, outcome data-flow, technical definitions and special-collection linkage gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Outcome 13 victim or witness unavailable definition
verified_claims: Outcome 13 applies where a named suspect is identified but the victim or key witness is dead or too ill to give evidence
limitations: the outcome is distinct from victim withdrawal

sources.name: Outcome 14 evidential-difficulty definition
verified_claims: Outcome 14 applies where no named suspect is identified and the victim declines or cannot support further action to identify the offender
limitations: the crime remains confirmed under the published definition

sources.name: Outcome 15 evidential-difficulty definition
verified_claims: Outcome 15 applies where a named suspect is identified and the victim supports action but evidential difficulties prevent further action
it can include a wanted suspect who cannot be traced
limitations: victim support does not guarantee sufficient evidence

sources.name: Outcome 16 victim non-support definition
verified_claims: Outcome 16 applies where a named suspect is identified but the victim does not support or withdraws support from police action
limitations: the outcome is not proof that the recorded crime did not occur

sources.name: Outcome 17 prosecution-time-limit definition
verified_claims: Outcome 17 applies where a suspect is identified but the prosecution time limit has expired
limitations: the outcome is procedural rather than an evidential acquittal

sources.name: Outcome 18 no-suspect investigation-complete definition
verified_claims: Outcome 18 applies where the crime has been investigated as far as reasonably possible and no suspect is identified
the case can be reopened if further opportunities arise
limitations: closed pending opportunities does not mean no offence occurred

sources.name: Outcome 19 NFIB-filed definition
verified_claims: Outcome 19 applies to NFIB fraud cases not allocated for investigation because there are insufficient lines of enquiry
limitations: Outcome 19 is limited to the national fraud process

sources.name: Outcome 20 other-body action definition
verified_claims: Outcome 20 applies when another body or agency will undertake further action and the victim is made aware
limitations: the police outcome does not describe the other body's eventual result

sources.name: Outcome 21 identified-suspect public-interest definition
verified_claims: Outcome 21 applies where further investigation capable of supporting formal action is not in the public interest, by police decision
limitations: the outcome differs from no-suspect and evidential-difficulty categories

sources.name: Outcome 22 diversionary-activity definition
verified_claims: Outcome 22 records diversionary, educational or intervention activity followed by a decision that further action is not in the public interest
use was voluntary from April 2019

sources.name: Outcome timeliness proxy limitation
verified_claims: timeliness measures elapsed time from offence recording to outcome assignment
it can be used as an efficiency proxy but is not a firm efficiency measure
limitations: case complexity and administration affect elapsed time

sources.name: Outcome system-recording lag
verified_claims: an outcome may be actioned on the same day but entered on the crime-recording system later
short one-to-five-day outcome times can include administrative delay
limitations: recorded assignment time is not always operational decision time

sources.name: Transferred or cancelled action-year rule
verified_claims: a transferred or cancelled record is counted in the financial year when the transfer or cancellation occurs
this can differ from the year the original offence was recorded
limitations: action-year counts should not be joined to original-year cohorts without care

sources.name: Transferred or cancelled comparison limitation
verified_claims: before March 2016 comparisons can only use the total of the five transfer or cancellation categories
high or low transfer or cancellation volumes are not inherently positive or negative
limitations: cross-force differences can reflect local recording practices

sources.name: Weapon-outcomes linkage and coverage
verified_claims: knife and firearm special collections are supplied separately and linked to main crime data to produce outcomes
the series moved from Official Statistics in Development for July 2025 to Official Statistics for July 2026
all 43 territorial forces supply both collections and British Transport Police additionally supplies knife data
limitations: the special collections remain selected-offence datasets rather than complete parcel-level crime records
